item.description: The American Cancer Society released new guidelines today that changes who should get tested for prostate cancer. Most men aged 50-69 should get screened every other year and those at higher risk should get a PSA test annually. The guidelines mean that men over 70 may get tested more after consulting with their doctors. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.
